```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm computation
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 50
    When the VTI for the current breath is above the threshold
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is active
    And the LOW VTI alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm computation
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 80
    When the VTI for the current breath is above the threshold
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    And the HIGH VTI alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: VTI computation
    Given the VTI for the current breath is 100
    When the VTI is computed
    Then the VTI is 100

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm computation
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 60
    When the VTE for the current breath is above the threshold
    Then the LOW VTE alarm is active

  Scenario Outline: Threshold setting
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the VTI for the current breath is above the threshold
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is active
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 0         |
      | 50        |
      | 90        |

  Scenario Outline: LOW VTI alarm inactivity
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the VTI for the current breath is below the threshold
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is inactive
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 0         |
      | 50        |
      | 90        |

  Scenario Outline: HIGH VTI alarm inactivity
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the VTI for the current breath is below the threshold
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm is inactive
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 0         |
      | 80        |
      | 90        |

  Scenario: Error handling
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 50
    When the VTI for the current breath is above the threshold
    And an error occurs
    Then an error message is displayed
```
